description: Kill a CLI/connector token. Whatever is using it stops working immediately and it cannot be restored — including, possibly, the credential this MCP server is running on. `confirm` must be the token id exactly. Ask the human first. Needs workspace:manage.

confirm.description: The exact token id, typed to authorize this irreversible action. Ask the human to confirm it first — do not fill this in from context on your own.

name: fillo_revoke_token
title: Revoke a connector token
